limitation: Existing legacy data is per user, not per workspace
plan: Layer 2 scoped chats/memory/goals; remaining legacy per-user stores tracked as L2-1/L2-2
resolution: Obsolete: Layer 2 scoped chats/memory/goals; the rest is L2-1/L2-2.

limitation: No frontend workspace UI
plan: Layer 4/8 frontend: workspace switcher on every page, /workspace
resolution: Obsolete: workspace switcher on every Layer 4/8 page and /workspace.

limitation: No ownership transfer
plan: Transactional ownership transfer (owner only) + API + UI
resolution: POST /api/workspaces/:id/transfer-ownership {newOwnerId}; RPC transfer_workspace_ownership (one transaction); UI in Workspace → Team; hardening L1-3 (memory + Postgres).

limitation: No email delivery for invitations
plan: Needs an email provider (SMTP/SendGrid) and a sending domain
resolution: Layer 10: optional invitation emails through Resend or SendGrid (services/invitationMailer.js; INVITE_EMAIL_PROVIDER/_API_KEY/_FROM + APP_BASE_URL); link /workspace#invite=<code> (code in the URL fragment); response reports sent / failed / not_configured honestly; tested against a local provider double (revenue L1-4). External step: verify a sending domain with the provider, set the four settings, invite a test address.

limitation: Frontend does not send verification emails although invites require a verified email
plan: Send Firebase verification email on sign-up + resend action
resolution: Auth.js sends the Firebase verification email on sign-up; Workspace → Team offers "Send verification email"; frontend tests.

limitation: No rate limit on invite acceptance
plan: DB-backed rate limit per user on /invitations/accept
resolution: DB-backed limiter: 20 acceptances / 10 min per user → 429; hardening L1-6.

limitation: Personalisation (profile, twin, timeline, graph…) is per user, used as prompt context in every workspace
plan: Legacy personal-assistant features; per-user by design, never exposes data to other users
resolution: Legacy personal-assistant data is per user by design and never shown to other users.

limitation: Cron/proactive jobs, command-center and data-controls read all of a user's rows across workspaces
plan: Data controls: workspace-scoped export/delete option + audit; cron/proactive remain per-user (own data only)
resolution: Data export/erasure cover only the caller's OWN rows (data-subject rights), now audited (data_exported / data_deleted, counts only); secret-looking columns are redacted in exports; DB error text is no longer returned. Cron/proactive jobs read only the owner's rows (unchanged by design).

limitation: Uploaded PDFs (pdf_vectors) not workspace-scoped
plan: workspace_id column + scoped reads/writes
resolution: pdf_vectors are private to the uploader (user_id scoped, never shared across users); workspace sharing of uploads would need pgvector RPC changes and is not an access-control gap.

limitation: auth.js treats /notifications/:x as a user id for every method (PATCH/DELETE broken)
plan: Match the user-id pattern only for GET /notifications/:userId
resolution: auth.js matches the user id only for GET /notifications/:userId; PATCH /:id/read and DELETE /:id are owner-checked in the route; hardening L2-4.

limitation: Unscoped writers (voice) land in the personal workspace
plan: Voice is frozen; voice has no workspace concept by design
resolution: Voice is frozen and has no workspace concept; its writes land in the personal workspace.

limitation: Memory search fails closed without pgvector search_memories_scoped
plan: Deliberate fail-closed behaviour; requires pgvector (documented in runbook)
resolution: Memory search fails closed without the pgvector RPC (safe default); documented.

limitation: Tasks do not auto-complete when an execution completes
plan: Deliberate: humans confirm completion; workflow-created agent tasks do move to done
resolution: Humans confirm task completion by design.

limitation: Web app does not send X-Workspace-Id for chat/memory/goals
plan: authFetch attaches the selected workspace to scoped routes
resolution: authFetch attaches X-Workspace-Id to /api/chat, /api/memory, /api/goals (also for callers that set Authorization themselves); a left workspace (404) is forgotten and retried in the personal one; frontend tests.

limitation: Single backend instance; runtime in-process
plan: Layer 6: execution ownership lease + fencing; Layer 9 adds a deterministic two-worker test
resolution: Execution leases + fenced jobs (Layer 6); Layer 9 deterministic two-worker crash test; load test with 20 tenants.

limitation: Cancellation takes effect between steps
plan: A step already sent to the desktop cannot be recalled; evidence is kept
resolution: A step already sent to the desktop cannot be recalled; evidence is kept.

limitation: Clarification ends the execution (NEEDS_INPUT)
plan: By design: resubmit with more detail; no mid-execution chat
resolution: Clarification ends the execution (NEEDS_INPUT) by design.

limitation: Nexus ApprovalGate only checks token presence
plan: Nexus-side verification lives in the frozen Nexus planner/recovery code; see ledger note
resolution: Inspected (read-only) nexus/common/approval.py: ApprovalGate checks token presence; the bridge only accepts requests carrying NEXUS_DEVICE_TOKEN from the backend, which is the approval authority (approvals are bound and single-use there). Verifying server-signed tokens inside Nexus would change controller.py's voice approval path, which is frozen. check-config now REQUIRES NEXUS_DEVICE_TOKEN whenever NEXUS_URL is set and https/loopback in production.

limitation: Planner input is not redacted
plan: Sanitize goal/tool output sent to the planner even when the firewall is off
resolution: Goal and history sent to the planner are always sanitized, even with the firewall off; agentExecution redaction test now asserts NO secret reaches any prompt (stricter).

limitation: No UI for executions
plan: Layer 8 /workspace Activity & approvals
resolution: Obsolete: Layer 8 Activity & approvals.

limitation: One worker instance
plan: Layer 6 fenced jobs; Layer 9 two-worker test
resolution: Fenced multi-worker jobs; Layer 9 two-worker test.

limitation: Linear steps only
plan: By design (predictable, auditable workflows)
resolution: Linear steps by design.

limitation: Output chaining is text only
plan: Layer 6 structured outputs; Layer 9 adds table and artifact-reference types
resolution: Structured outputs: string, number, boolean, object, array + Layer 9 table ({columns, rows}, bounded, scalar cells) and artifact reference (https or opaque id, no credentials/traversal); text outputs unchanged.

limitation: Waiting runs hold a worker slot
plan: Bounded by the 15-minute approval TTL and maxConcurrent; documented in runbook
resolution: Waiting runs hold a slot, bounded by approval TTL and maxConcurrent.

limitation: Schedules are interval-based, no cron/timezone
plan: Deliberate simple scheduling; not a correctness or security gap
resolution: Interval schedules by design (policy time windows now support IANA zones, L6-4).

limitation: API triggering uses the user token
plan: Layer 6 workspace API keys
resolution: Obsolete: Layer 6 API keys.

limitation: Retries are conservative (non-idempotent actions need human retry)
plan: Safety rule required by Layer 9 Phase 2: never auto-replay uncertain writes
resolution: Required safety rule: uncertain writes are never auto-replayed (needs_review); proven by the two-worker test.

limitation: GitHub authenticated reads/writes not tested against real GitHub
plan: Needs a GitHub token / OAuth app
resolution: GitHub reads/writes are tested against a local GitHub API double only. External step: connect a real repository with a fine-grained PAT and run list_issues/read_file/create_issue once.

limitation: Google Drive not implemented
plan: Read-only Drive connector behind the same gateway/firewall, tested against a local double; live validation needs Google OAuth client (B)
resolution: Read-only Google Drive connector (list_files, get_file, read_text) through the gateway + firewall, folder allowlist, token refresh, workspace OAuth connect — tested against a local Drive/Google-token double. External step: create a Google OAuth client, set GOOGLE_DRIVE_ENABLED + GOOGLE_OAUTH_*, connect a test Google account, run the three actions (Google app verification is needed for external users).

limitation: HTTP connector: no query-string auth
plan: authType 'query' (credential in a named query parameter, redacted everywhere)
resolution: HTTP connector authType "query" (authQueryParam); key never in evidence/audit/logs; clients cannot set that parameter; redirects not followed; hardening L5-3.

limitation: HTTP connector: POST bodies JSON ≤16 KB
plan: Deliberate bound
resolution: POST bodies are JSON ≤16 KB by design.

limitation: HTTP connector: only JSON/text responses parsed
plan: Deliberate: binary content is not fed to the agent
resolution: Binary responses are not fed to the agent by design.

limitation: Credential rotation manual; no re-encryption job
plan: scripts/rotate-integration-keys.js re-encrypts under the current key (dry-run, counts only)
resolution: scripts/rotate-integration-keys.js re-encrypts every credential under the current key (CAS, dry run, counts only); tested memory + Postgres incl. concurrent runs.

limitation: Legacy GitHub OAuth plaintext tokens + guessable state
plan: Layer 6 OAuth migration + trigger + migrate-legacy-github-tokens.js
resolution: Obsolete: Layer 6 moved legacy GitHub tokens into the encrypted store.

limitation: GitHub OAuth not verified with a real OAuth app
plan: Needs GITHUB_CLIENT_ID/SECRET
resolution: GitHub OAuth flow tested against a local OAuth double. External step: register a GitHub OAuth/GitHub App, set GITHUB_CLIENT_ID/SECRET/REDIRECT_URI, complete one workspace connect and one refresh.

limitation: Voice/run_goal path not behind the workspace firewall
plan: Voice is frozen; keeps its own risk/approval gates
resolution: Voice / run_goal path is frozen; it keeps its own risk and approval gates.

limitation: Entropy detector is heuristic
plan: Backstop only; pattern detectors are primary
resolution: Entropy detector is a heuristic backstop by design.

limitation: Policy time windows are UTC only
plan: Optional IANA timezone in policy
resolution: schedule.timeZone (IANA, DST-aware via Intl); invalid zones rejected; hardening L6-4.

limitation: Workspace OAuth completion depends on sessionStorage of the starting browser
plan: Security property (binds completion to the initiating browser)
resolution: Binding OAuth completion to the initiating browser is a security property.

limitation: OAuth refresh tokens / expiring GitHub user tokens not handled
plan: Store refresh token encrypted; refresh on expiry/401 via SSRF-safe client
resolution: Expiring GitHub App user tokens and Google tokens are refreshed via the SSRF-safe client, stored encrypted, audited; single flight per instance and re-read across instances for single-use refresh tokens; hardening L6-6.

limitation: No payment provider
plan: Layer 8 Stripe adapter
resolution: Obsolete: Layer 8 Stripe adapter.

limitation: Count-based limits checked, not reserved (members, active workflows)
plan: Post-write verification with compensation so concurrent requests can never exceed a limit
resolution: members and active_workflows: post-write verification under a per-workspace row lock (RPCs enforce_member_limit / enforce_active_workflow_limit); an over-limit writer undoes its own write. Exactly the free capacity is granted under concurrency (memory + Postgres).

limitation: Connector-call limits checked not reserved
plan: Race-free: one active execution per workspace is a DB unique index; proven by test
resolution: Obsolete: one active execution per workspace is a DB unique index; connector calls are reserved per execution.

limitation: Usage retention only bounds the API; ledger rows never deleted
plan: Retention purge (usage, executions, runs, audit with floor) — owner/admin + worker, audited
resolution: Real retention: RPC retention_purge_workspace (usage ledger, reservations, finished runs/executions + cascades, audit) with DB-enforced floors; owner settings, "Apply now", periodic sweep on workers; audited with counts; tested on Postgres.

limitation: max_concurrent_executions informational
plan: Enforced through checkEntitlement in createExecution
resolution: max_concurrent_executions enforced in createExecution (0 → 402 before anything starts).

limitation: Stripe not exercised against Stripe test mode
plan: Needs STRIPE test keys + webhook endpoint
resolution: Stripe tested against a deterministic Stripe API double only (no Stripe account/keys supplied). External step: the test-mode checklist in PRODUCTION_RUNBOOK.md §6 with sk_test keys and a webhook endpoint.

limitation: Plan changes via Stripe Customer Portal configuration
plan: Portal products configured in the Stripe dashboard
resolution: Plan changes for existing subscribers use the Stripe Customer Portal; its products must be configured in the Stripe dashboard.

limitation: Display prices operator-set, not read from Stripe
plan: Deliberate: no provider call on every page view
resolution: Display prices are operator-set (no provider call per page view).

limitation: Invitations not emailed
plan: Same as L1-4
resolution: Layer 10: optional invitation emails through Resend or SendGrid (services/invitationMailer.js; INVITE_EMAIL_PROVIDER/_API_KEY/_FROM + APP_BASE_URL); link /workspace#invite=<code> (code in the URL fragment); response reports sent / failed / not_configured honestly; tested against a local provider double (revenue L1-4). External step: verify a sending domain with the provider, set the four settings, invite a test address.

limitation: Overview latency/success uses the last 50 records
plan: Bounded query by design; 30-day totals come from the ledger
resolution: Bounded overview queries by design; 30-day totals come from the ledger.

limitation: First safe task needs the desktop bridge
plan: Needs a running Nexus desktop agent
resolution: Desktop/browser actions need a running Nexus desktop agent on the customer machine.

limitation: Emergency stop is global (voice route)
plan: Voice route unchanged (frozen); add a workspace-scoped kill switch in the firewall policy
resolution: Workspace emergency stop in the firewall policy (owner/admin, Security page); denies every agent/connector action before it is sent; hardening PRE-1.

limitation: Voice resume re-asks planner; RED always 403 on /api/command; resumePlan unreachable
plan: Voice/planner frozen
resolution: Voice/planner frozen.

limitation: PERMISSIONS_ENFORCED follow-ups (voice re-send, extra round trip)
plan: Voice frozen; check-config warns when not enforced
resolution: Voice frozen; check-config warns while PERMISSIONS_ENFORCED is not true.

limitation: Legacy productivity module keeps Google tokens/reminders in memory
plan: Legacy personal module outside Nexus B2B; nothing persisted, no secret leaves the process
resolution: Legacy personal productivity module (in-memory only, outside Nexus B2B).

limitation: Legacy UI TODO
plan: Legacy personal dashboard widget
resolution: Legacy personal dashboard widget TODO.

limitation: Migrations create pgcrypto (local test needed a placeholder extension)
plan: Only core gen_random_uuid() is used: make the extension conditional so no placeholder is needed
resolution: pgcrypto created only if available; L1–L9 up/down applied on a fresh PostgreSQL 16 with the pgcrypto extension REMOVED from the server.

limitation: Schema invariants not verified automatically
plan: Schema audit SQL: RLS, public-role denial, FK/index on workspace_id for every Layer 1–9 table
resolution: scripts/schema-audit.sql: RLS, anon/authenticated privileges and policies, workspace_id FK + index, RPC execute grants; 0 violations; negative control detects injected violations.

limitation: Adversarial prompt-injection regression suite
plan: Layer 9 suite: injections via connector/GitHub/document/workflow input
resolution: Injection regression: Drive document, GitHub issue title, API response → tainted, a following write waits for a human, policy/roles unchanged, nothing sent to the attacker.

limitation: Approval binding verification across all properties
plan: Layer 9 tests: replay, expiry, cross-workspace, stale step, changed input/risk/resource
resolution: Approval: replay (one winner), cross-workspace and cross-execution 404, reuse 409; plus the Layer 6 AA/AB binding tests (step, policy version, input tamper, expiry).

limitation: API lacks list endpoints, pagination/filtering and request IDs
plan: GET /runs, GET /executions with cursor pagination; X-Request-Id on every response
resolution: GET /api/automation/v1/runs and /executions with keyset cursors, status/workflow filters, key workflow restrictions, X-Request-Id; OpenAPI updated (spec-vs-router test).

limitation: No worker health / ops metrics
plan: Worker heartbeat + admin ops metrics
resolution: Worker heartbeats, /health/ready, token-protected /metrics (route groups only), request ids in responses and error logs.

limitation: ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED_API=true disables auth even with NODE_ENV=production
plan: Refuse the bypass in production (fail closed)
resolution: ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED_API is ignored when NODE_ENV=production (fail closed, logged).

limitation: No load test
plan: Load test script + measurements
resolution: __tests__/load/loadTest.js measured on memory and on local PostgreSQL (see LAYER9_HARDENING.md §6).

limitation: No production runbook
plan: docs/PRODUCTION_RUNBOOK.md
resolution: docs/PRODUCTION_RUNBOOK.md; check-config extended.

limitation: No repository/database/runtime secret scan tooling
plan: scripts/secret-scan.js (repo + optional DB) + runtime scan in tests
resolution: scripts/secret-scan.js (repository + --db); runtime scan in the Layer 9 suite.

limitation: authFetch attached the Firebase ID token to ANY origin whose path starts with /api/
plan: Token only for same-origin /api/ or configured backend origins; frontend test.
resolution: Token only for same-origin /api/ or configured backend origins; frontend test.

limitation: Generated code awaiting a GitHub push was kept in localStorage; push result opened with window.open without noopener
plan: sessionStorage (tab-scoped); https-only window.open with noopener,noreferrer.
resolution: sessionStorage (tab-scoped); https-only window.open with noopener,noreferrer.

limitation: Count-limit compensation could deny ALL concurrent writers on Postgres (livelock)
plan: Serialized verification RPCs (L7-2).
resolution: Serialized verification RPCs (L7-2).

limitation: Ownership-transfer body field "userId" collided with the auth middleware's caller check
plan: Field renamed newOwnerId (found by the Layer 9 HTTP test).
resolution: Field renamed newOwnerId (found by the Layer 9 HTTP test).

limitation: Layer 9 down migration restored the Layer 7 trigger with different whitespace
plan: Down restores the Layer 7 body byte-identically (md5 checked).
resolution: Down restores the Layer 7 body byte-identically (md5 checked).

limitation: Occasional timing failure of a Layer 4 restart-recovery test when the whole backend suite runs back-to-back (pre-existing; seen once in Layer 8 and once in Layer 9; passes in isolation and on reruns)
plan: Pre-existing, cause not identified: in 2 of ~12 full back-to-back suite runs one Layer 4 restart-recovery test failed; it passes in isolation and on every rerun, on memory and Postgres. Not changed (tests are not weakened). Product code is not involved (the test simulates process crashes with timed lease expiry).
resolution: Root cause found in Layer 10: a job claim that resolved AFTER workflowRunner.stop() was still driven by the stopping (or "crashed") instance, whose execution service did not own the new executions, so the live instance reconciled them as SERVER_RESTART. Reproduced 3/12 under parallel load; fixed (a late claim is handed back, or left to expire for an abandoned stop); regression test revenue P16-2 + mutation; 16/16 parallel stress runs and 8 back-to-back full suites clean afterwards. Note: in production executions also carry a 30 s ownership lease (MULTI_INSTANCE_EXECUTION), which already protected live executions.

limitation: Browser/desktop/file safety for dangerous actions
plan: Existing Layer 6 firewall (AB tests: deletes, credential files, uploads, protected paths, terminal, session export) re-verified; workspace emergency stop added (PRE-1). No engine change.
resolution: Existing Layer 6 firewall (AB tests: deletes, credential files, uploads, protected paths, terminal, session export) re-verified; workspace emergency stop added (PRE-1). No engine change.

limitation: E-commerce competitor intelligence module
plan: Layer 10
resolution: Products, competitor listings, deterministic matching (GTIN/marketplace id/URL/brand+MPN verified; weaker signals unverified; conflicts → 0; human decisions final), margin impact without invented inputs, recommendations from VERIFIED data only, dashboard. revenue P2-*.

limitation: Generic monitoring engine
plan: Layer 10
resolution: web_page / Shopify / JSON (web or authenticated HTTP) / API submissions; VERIFIED/UNVERIFIED/STALE/UNAVAILABLE; structured extraction only; idempotent checks; lease + fence worker; revenue P3-*, P16-1; PostgreSQL run.

limitation: Alert delivery to real Slack / email providers
plan: Layer 10
resolution: Slack Incoming Webhook and Resend/SendGrid connectors with stored delivery state, tested against local provider doubles only (no real accounts). External step: runbook §12 items 1-2.

limitation: Reading Amazon / Flipkart product pages directly
plan: Layer 10
resolution: Marketplace terms forbid automated page access. Supported instead: their official / partner APIs through the HTTP connector (json_api), API submissions (UNVERIFIED), and pages the seller may read (own store, Shopify). A blocked page is reported UNAVAILABLE, never guessed.

limitation: Automatic re-pricing
plan: Layer 10
resolution: By design: recommendations never change a price; acting on one creates a task or a governed workflow run (firewall + approval + evidence).

limitation: Prices rendered only by client-side JavaScript without structured data
plan: Layer 10
resolution: Never guessed from text (NO_STRUCTURED_DATA → UNAVAILABLE). Use the site's JSON endpoint (json_api) or a browser-agent workflow step, whose result is agent evidence, not a VERIFIED observation.

limitation: AI agent QA / reliability testing
plan: Layer 10
resolution: Projects/suites/scenarios, nexus_agent / workflow / external_agent executors, independent probes, 15 failure categories with evidence, metrics and flakiness from stored results, API. revenue P4-*.

limitation: Executable templates
plan: Layer 10
resolution: 17 templates (9 new incl. multi-agent pipeline and human review), metadata derived from steps; instantiated, published and run in tests (P5-*).

limitation: Human–AI collaboration
plan: Layer 10
resolution: Named agents with limits enforced in Layer 3 on top of the firewall, agent tasks, review steps with reviewer roles. revenue P6-*.

limitation: Execution API, webhooks, SDK
plan: Layer 10
resolution: Evidence/QA/monitoring/usage endpoints + scopes (OpenAPI parity test), signed webhooks with outbox/backoff/dead-letter, JS SDK (mcis/sdk/js).

limitation: Webhook delivery to a real https receiver on the internet
plan: Layer 10
resolution: Delivery, signing and backoff tested against a local receiver (http) and, on PostgreSQL, the failure path over https. External step: runbook §12 item 4.

limitation: Billing for new dimensions
plan: Layer 10
resolution: monitoring_checks, agent_test_scenarios (metered), monitored_products, integrations (race-free counts); built-in plan limits set by the migration; legacy plans unlimited for the new keys. No prices invented (display prices remain operator-set; Stripe prices remain L8-1/L8-3).

limitation: Workspace export / delete
plan: Layer 10
resolution: Owner export without secrets; delete with name confirmation, subscription and running-work guards, audit purge + one content-free row, full cascade (deferred FKs) verified on PostgreSQL.

limitation: Production capacity
plan: Layer 10
resolution: Load measured on the test machine only (LAYER10_REVENUE.md §12); production numbers need the production database and network.

limitation: Sensitive-data filter redacted the last group of ~0.3% of UUIDs (12 digits starting 2-9 matched the Aadhaar pattern), corrupting ids in audit rows, evidence and webhook payloads (seen as a rare workflow-schedule test failure)
plan: Layer 10
resolution: Aadhaar and card-number patterns no longer match inside a larger token (UUID / hex id); real Aadhaar and card numbers are still redacted. Regression test revenue P10-1 (50 000 random UUIDs) + mutation.

limitation: Workflow runner could drive a job claimed after stop()
plan: Layer 10
resolution: See L9-N6.

limitation: Server start-up crashed with the revenue suite on (the default): the webhook credential service was created without a store ("credential store is required")
plan: Layer 10
resolution: routes/revenue.js passes a store that refuses every call (webhooks only encrypt/decrypt; the Layer 5 integration-credential store is never used on this path). Found by the local start-up smoke; regression test revenue P25-1 (fails on the old code); server boots in dev, production and integrations+key modes.

limitation: Many concurrent API submissions to ONE monitor could exhaust the 25-attempt optimistic update loop on a slower database → 409 MONITOR_CONFLICT; the observation was stored but never applied, and a client retry with the same key only replayed it
plan: Layer 10
resolution: monitoringService.js serializes applying observations per monitor inside a process (the version check still guards other instances). Found by the local PostgreSQL load test; regression test revenue P25-2 (old code: 176 of 216 version checks failed; fixed: 0) + mutation #43; local PostgreSQL load passes (200 monitors, one observation per key).
